leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fourteenth season of , Pokémon: Black & White, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fourteenth season of , Pokémon: Black & White, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Two Black & White Collections were released by in 2012, containing the whole season between them. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

===Pokémon: Black & White - Collection 1===
 
Pokémon: Black & White - Collection 1 was released by in Australia and New Zealand on February 15, 2012. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DBX13913.

Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself. The featured Pokémon appears in at least one of the episodes on that disc, and is typically an important Pokémon in one of them.
 

===Pokémon: Black & White - Collection 2===
 
 
Pokémon: Black & White - Collection 2 was released by in Australia on June 6, 2012 and in New Zealand on May 25, 2012. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DBX13914.

====Contents====
 

==Season 14 disc set==
 
 
 (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing DigiPack disc sets of each season in 2010.

The Season 14 DigiPack disc set was released by in Australia on December 3, 2012 and in New Zealand on December 5, 2012. It contains six discs with 48 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE4192. The DigiPack disc set was re-released exclusive to JB Hi-Fi online on July 14, 2016 and in JB Hi-Fi stores on September 21, 2016 to celebrate the Pokémon 20th Anniversary. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment in a slimline case in Australia on April 2, 2014 with a different cover and the catalogue number BHE5398.

===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself. The featured Pokémon appears in at least one of the episodes on that disc, and is typically an important Pokémon in one of them.
 

==Sample disc==
 
A sample disc DVD of the series was released by . It contains 3 episodes.

==Multi-season releases==
The following are English language Region 4 multi-season releases that include Black & White episodes.
Pokémon Unova Collection
Pokémon: Heritage Collection II
Pokémon Seasons 1-19: Deluxe Edition
Pokémon Seasons 1-20: Ultra Collection
Pokémon Seasons 1-21: Mega Collection
